slides.heading: Aaditya Thackeray Writes to Chief Minister on Pagdi Buildings
slides.text: Aaditya Thackeray, Shiv Sena UBT leader, writes to Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis on the redevelopment of pagdi buildings in Mumbai.

slides.heading: Pagdi Buildings
slides.text: Pagdi buildings are old tenanted buildings where occupiers paid a large one-time amount to the landlord and then paid a low monthly rent, giving tenant semi-ownership rights.
slides.image_search_query: Pagdi buildings Maharashtra Rent Control Act India

slides.heading: Thackeray's Demand
slides.text: Thackeray demands statutory and policy reforms for the redevelopment of cessed and non-cessed pagdi buildings in Mumbai, including clearing the way for the redevelopment of 935 highly dangerous pagdi buildings.
